images.note: Real screenshot from Snowflake's own 'Getting Started with Snowflake' Quickstart, from its dedicated 'Working with Roles, Account Admin, & Account Usage' section. Shows the Switch Role menu in Snowsight's user-preferences panel with the full built-in role hierarchy visible: ACCOUNTADMIN, SECURITYADMIN, USERADMIN, SYSADMIN, PUBLIC, plus the quickstart's own custom JUNIOR_DBA and ORGADMIN roles.

imageNote: Same quickstart the pilot lesson (Lesson 1) used, but a different image from its role section (9Role_1.png through 9Role_6.png) — 9Role_4.png is the Switch Role dropdown, the clearest single screenshot of the complete role list. Lesson 1's own screenshot file (6Query_1.png, saved there as snowsight-worksheet.png) was deliberately not reused.
